summary: Vasudev Vishwanath Gokhale (1901–1991) was an Indologist and philosopher who completed his PhD at the University of Bonn in 1930. He held posts at Fergusson College, Visva-Bharati University, and served as Professor at the University of Delhi from 1959.

Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi (1893–1985) was an Indologist and historian who earned his BA at Deccan College and PhD at the University of Mumbai. He served as Principal of Morris College and was later Hon. Professor at Nagpur University (1957–1966).

Vasudeva Sharan Agrawala (1904–1967) worked in Indology and archaeology, holding degrees from Banaras Hindu University and the University of Lucknow. He served as Curator at Mathura, Director of the State Museum Lucknow, and Superintendent with the Archaeological Survey of India.

Vasudha Dalmia (born 1947) is an Indologist who studied at Miranda House, Cologne, JNU, and Heidelberg. She taught at the University of Tübingen, was a Professor at UC Berkeley (2001–2012), and served as Professor of Hindu Studies at Yale (2013–2014).

Vasudha Narayanan (born 1953) is a religious studies and Indology scholar educated at the universities of Madras, Mumbai, and Harvard. Since around 1982, she has been a Distinguished Professor at the University of Florida, also serving as AAR President (2001–2002).

Vasumati Karandikar is a scholar in Indology and philosophy. She completed an MA at the University of Mumbai (2017–2019, 2022–2024) and earned a PhD from Kavikulaguru Kalidas Sanskrit University in 2021.

Vatroslav Jagić (1838–1923) was a linguist who studied under Miklosich at Vienna and completed a PhD under August Leskien at Leipzig. He held professorships at Odesa (1871–1874), Berlin (1874–1880), Saint Petersburg (1880–1886), and Vienna (1886–1909).

Vedprakash Sharma is an Indology scholar who completed his undergraduate studies at the University of Delhi (1980–1985) and earned a PhD from Maharshi Dayanand University (2005–2008). He served as a Research Associate at the University of Delhi.

Veeranarayana N. K. Pandurangi (born 1973) is an Indology and philosophy scholar with doctorates from Central and National Sanskrit Universities. He worked at Poornaprajna Vidyapeetha, the French Institute of Pondicherry, Rajasthan Sanskrit University, and Karnataka Samskrit University.

Velcheru Narayana Rao (born 1933) is an Indologist who earned his MA and PhD from Andhra University. He was a long-time faculty member at the University of Wisconsin-Madison from 1971 and held visiting professorships at Chicago and Emory.

Velizar Sadovski (born 1972) is a scholar of linguistics, Indology, and Iranian studies who completed his PhD at the University of Vienna in 2001. He has served as a Senior Scientist at the Austrian Academy of Sciences since 1998.

Vempati Kutumba Sastry (born 1950) is an Indologist and philosopher. He served as Vice-Chancellor of Central Sanskrit University (2003–2008) and as President of the International Association of Sanskrit Studies from around 2006 to 2018.
Ven. Dhammapāla is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Bhante Dhammasakkaro and completed a PhD at the University of Hong Kong under the supervision of K. L. Dhammajoti.

Venoth Nallisamy is an Indology scholar who earned degrees from Universiti Malaysia Sabah, Open University Malaysia, and a PhD from the University of Malaya. In 2024, he was appointed Senior Lecturer at INTI International University.

Vera Aleksandrovna Novikova (1918–1972) was an Indologist and linguist who studied under Aleksej Petrovič Barannikov and Aleksandr Semënovič Zimin at Saint Petersburg State University. She held posts at the Institute of Oriental Manuscripts and Saint Petersburg State University.

Verity Harte (born 1968) is a philosopher who studied at the University of Cambridge (1986–1994). After research and lecturing positions at Oxford and King's College London, she was appointed Professor of Philosophy and Classics at Yale University in 2006.

Verrier Elwin (1902–1964) was an anthropologist and Indologist educated at Merton College, Oxford. He served as Deputy-Director of the Anthropological Survey of India (1946–1949) and Adviser for Tribal Affairs for the North-East Frontier Agency from 1954.

Vesna Wallace (born 1952) is an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar who earned her doctorate from UC Berkeley. She held the Numata Chair at the University of Oxford until 2010 and is a professor at UC Santa Barbara.

Vicente Fatone (1903–1962) was a philosopher and Indologist who studied at the University of Calcutta (1937–1938). He held professorships at the National University of the Litoral (1929), National University of La Plata (1940), and University of Buenos Aires (1960).

Victor A. van Bijlert is an Indologist and philosopher who earned his PhD from Leiden University in 1987. He held positions at the Nordic Institute of Asian Studies, IIM Calcutta, Leiden University, and Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam until 2021.
